mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (openid, name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, create_time) VALUES (#{openid}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{avatar}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, openid, name, phone, sex, id_number AS idNumber, avatar, create_time AS createTime FROM user WHERE openid = #{openid}
SELECT id, name, type, sort, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM category ORDER BY sort ASC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, dish_id AS dishId, setmeal_id AS setmealId, name, image, dish_flavor AS dishFlavor, number, amount, create_time AS createTime FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
